deep_review.conclusion: Inventory is complete. Production use requires independent cryptographic review, TLS, protected Redis/file storage, retention and deletion verification, endpoint permission review and careful handling of links and URL fragments; no secret or service was exercised.

semantic_review_progress.scoped_deep_review: Sensitive-data and cryptographic-protocol trigger reviewed narrowly. Source documentation and implementations place AES-GCM encryption/decryption in clients, keep decryption keys in URL fragments, store ciphertext plus hashed read tokens server-side and bound reads. Static review does not establish cryptographic correctness, deployment TLS, storage isolation or operational deletion guarantees.
